US-Iran Tensions Impact Global Markets and Alliances

Renewed tensions between the United States and Iran, particularly concerning the Strait of Hormuz and potential military actions, have led to a decline in Indian stock markets. Simultaneously, US President Trump's actions and statements at a NATO summit, including trade threats towards Spain and discussions about F-35 fighter jets involving Turkey, have caused diplomatic ripples and concern among allies.
